readerCopy.body: An old responsibility may return because it was never fully released. Saturn conjunct the South Node can bring a former obligation, authority structure, debt of time, or role you have carried for years back into focus. You may be the obvious person to handle it because you already know the system and everyone trusts you to be responsible. That history matters, but it does not create an endless contract. Finish what is actually yours, renegotiate what has changed, and stop treating familiarity as proof that the burden still belongs to you.
